author: Patrick Tomasso
description:
#movies #cinematography 

I sat down with Ben Stiller to drink some Stiller's Soda and talk about our favourite cinematographers. We get into Gordon Willis, shooting on film vs. digital, Spielberg, the art of shooting comedy, working with John Toll on TROPIC THUNDER, and reuniting with Emmanuel Lubezki + plus his new movie FOCKER IN LAW in theatres Nov 25. 

Thank you to Universal Pictures and Stiller's Soda.
title: The cinematography that inspired Ben Stiller
